Test Scenario: Verify successful user registration and profile details
Test Steps: 1. Open Register page. 2. Enter valid registration details. 3. Submit registration. 4. Login with the registered credentials. 5. Open My Profile.
Expected Result: User is registered, can log in, and profile shows the registered name and email.

Test Scenario: Verify successful login with valid credentials
Test Steps: 1. Open Sign in page. 2. Enter valid email and password. 3. Click Login.
Expected Result: User is successfully logged in and Sign in link is hidden.

Test Steps: 1. Enter valid email and invalid password. 2. Click Login.
Expected Result: Appropriate error message is displayed and login is denied.

Test Scenario: Verify COD checkout and invoice confirmation
Test Steps: 1. Proceed to checkout. 2. Enter valid billing details. 3. Select Cash on Delivery. 4. Press Confirm/Finish twice.
Expected Result: Order confirmation is shown with invoice number (INV-*).

Test Scenario: Verify generated invoice appears under My Invoices
Test Steps: 1. Capture invoice number from confirmation. 2. Open user menu. 3. Open My Invoices.
